title: Moving to Kraków (for Polish citizens)
forWhom: Polish citizens relocating and moving their residence to Kraków.

steps.title: Registration of permanent or temporary residence (zameldowanie)
steps.why: Statutory registration obligation. Enables access to Kraków City Card discounts, voter lists, and school district assignments.
steps.when: No later than the 30th day from arriving at the new address

steps.title: Update address in vehicle registration certificate
steps.why: Requirement to keep vehicle registration records aligned with the owner's actual residence.

steps.title: Select a primary care physician (POZ)
steps.why: Ensuring public NFZ healthcare coverage close to the new place of residence.

title: First Steps for EU Citizens (EU/EEA/Switzerland)
forWhom: Citizens of EU/EEA member states and Switzerland and their family members.

steps.title: Registration of foreigner residence (zameldowanie)
steps.why: Fulfillment of statutory residence registration for foreigners staying in Poland for more than 3 months.
steps.when: No later than the 30th day from arrival (if staying more than 3 months)

steps.title: Register EU citizen stay at the Voivodship Office
steps.why: Legal requirement for EU citizen stays exceeding 3 months (administered by Małopolska Voivode).
steps.when: On the day following the end of 3 months from entry into Poland

external.title: Department for Foreigners of the Małopolska Voivodship Office

steps.title: Public transport card and getting around Kraków
steps.why: Purchasing public transit passes or applying for Kraków City Card for local mobility.

title: First Steps for Non-EU Foreigners
forWhom: Third-country nationals (non-EU/EEA) relocating to Kraków for work, study, or family.

steps.title: Obtaining a PESEL number upon application
steps.why: Crucial national identification number required for banking, taxation, healthcare, and public administration.
steps.when: Upon arrival in Poland with a legal basis

steps.title: Foreigner residence registration (zameldowanie)
steps.why: Official confirmation of address in Kraków, required for residence permit procedures.
steps.when: No later than the 4th day from arrival if staying more than 30 days

steps.title: Legalization of residence — Residence Card (Urząd Wojewódzki)
steps.why: Submitting a temporary residence permit application to the Małopolska Voivodship Office (state administration).
steps.when: No later than the last day of legal stay in Poland

steps.title: Integration support and social counselling (MOPS)
steps.why: Advisory support and integration assistance provided by the Municipal Social Welfare Centre in Kraków.

title: First Steps for Citizens of Ukraine Under Temporary Protection
forWhom: Ukrainian citizens and their family members arriving in Kraków due to war.

steps.title: Obtaining PESEL number with UKR status
steps.why: Confirmation of temporary protection, legal stay, public healthcare eligibility, and access to work and benefits.

steps.title: Address registration (zameldowanie)
steps.why: Official proof of local residence simplifying kindergarten and school enrolment.
steps.when: No later than the 4th day from arrival (if staying more than 30 days)

steps.title: Registration at the Municipal Labour Office (GUP Kraków)
steps.why: Assistance with employment, traineeships, and free Polish language courses.

steps.title: Social welfare and integration assistance (MOPS)
steps.why: Social support services, counseling, and integration assistance provided by MOPS Kraków.

title: Family with Children: Childcare, Education, and Support
forWhom: Parents and legal guardians residing in Kraków with children under 18.

steps.title: Enrolment in nurseries, kids clubs, or kindergartens
steps.why: Early childhood care and preschool education via Kraków's centralized electronic recruitment system.
steps.when: According to the spring admission calendar or upon available slots during the year

steps.title: Enrolment in primary or secondary school
steps.why: Fulfilling statutory school obligation. District primary schools are guaranteed for children residing in the school's catchment area.
steps.when: Before the school year starts or anytime throughout the year

steps.title: Family allowance and supplements
steps.why: Municipal financial assistance for families with eligible income thresholds to support childcare costs.
steps.when: Applications accepted for the applicable benefit period

steps.title: School social scholarship
steps.why: Financial assistance for students in need to cover educational supplies and school books.

title: Job Search and Career Development in Kraków
forWhom: Individuals seeking employment, unemployed residents, or professionals looking to upskill.

steps.title: Registration as a jobseeker
steps.why: Access to local vacancies database, career advisory services, and activation events.

steps.title: Registration as unemployed
steps.why: Public health insurance coverage, unemployment benefits (subject to statutory eligibility), and vocational programs.
steps.when: Anytime following termination of previous employment

steps.title: Professional trainings and reskilling
steps.why: Funding opportunities for certified courses, professional qualifications, and training stipends.
steps.when: During open recruitment windows for training programs

title: Vehicle Registration and Formalities in Kraków
forWhom: Vehicle owners relocating to Kraków or acquiring a vehicle in Poland or from abroad.

steps.title: Registration of a used vehicle purchased in Poland
steps.why: Transfer of vehicle registration title to the new owner's details in Kraków.

steps.title: Registration of a vehicle imported from abroad
steps.why: Official road registration in Poland following technical inspection and excise duty payment.

steps.title: Update of address in vehicle registration document
steps.why: Reflecting the owner's updated address of residence in vehicle records.

steps.title: Registration of a new vehicle
steps.why: First registration of a new, never registered vehicle; you get a temporary permit (valid 30 days) and plates on the spot.

title: Student Guide to Kraków
forWhom: Higher education students (UJ, AGH, PK, UEK, etc.) moving to Kraków for their studies.

steps.title: Temporary residence registration in dorm or rental apartment
steps.why: Statutory address registration for local and international students staying in Kraków.
steps.when: Within 30 days of arrival (or 4/30 days for foreign nationals)

steps.title: Student public transit pass (KMK) & City Card
steps.why: Accessing 50% statutory student fare discount on buses and trams using a valid student ID.
steps.when: Before starting daily commute in the city

steps.title: Registration with Kraków Library branches
steps.why: Free access to literature, academic databases, quiet study rooms, and local neighborhood branches.
